# betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_v2 (Resource)

Manages a Generic (v2) Service Connection within Azure DevOps, supporting arbitrary endpoint types and authorization schemes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "betterado_serviceendpoint_generic_v2" "example" {
  project_id           = betterado_project.example.id
  name                 = "Example Generic V2 Service Connection"
  description          = "Managed by Terraform"
  type                 = "generic"
  server_url           = "https://example.com"
  authorization_scheme = "UsernamePassword"

  authorization_parameters = {
    username = "myuser"
    password = "mypassword"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `authorization_scheme` (String) The authorization scheme used for the service connection.
- `name` (String) The name of the service endpoint.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the project.
- `server_url` (String) The server URL of the service connection.
- `type` (String) The type of the service endpoint (e.g. 'generic', 'github', etc.).

### Optional

- `authorization_parameters` (Map of String, Sensitive) A map of authorization parameters for the service connection.
- `description` (String) The Service Endpoint description.
- `parameters` (Map of String) A map of endpoint-specific data parameters.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of the service endpoint.
